code.note: the official v2 evaluator is NOT in the PersonaMem v1 checkout; this repo was cloned read-only into the audit area

census.note_on_999: the HF file listing shows 999 persona ids across the whole dataset, but benchmark/text/benchmark.csv uses 200 of them; README states train/val have NO persona_id overlap with benchmark

runs.relationship: N/A within this split -- exactly one 32k history, one 128k history and one raw persona file per persona
runs.note: the dataset-wide listing carries 2 run timestamps per size, but the released text benchmark references only 250913_163134 (32k) and 250913_163556 (128k); had both been referenced they would have been merged as SAME_PERSONA_REGENERATION
runs.size_variants: 32k and 128k are two versions of the SAME persona history (128k pads with persona-irrelevant math/coding content); they are NOT independent and only one size may be used

evidence: the file is benchmark/text/benchmark.csv; multimodal is a separate file and a separate --use_multimodal flag
official README: data/chat_history_32k and data/chat_history_128k are 'All histories are text-only'
6 sampled histories contain messages with keys exactly {role, content} -- no image/audio fields

correctness.mcq_mechanism: create_mcq_options() shuffles [correct_answer]+3 incorrect into A-D; check_mcq_correctness() returns option_mapping[pred.upper()] == correct_answer -- exact string equality
correctness.llm_judge_present_but_not_default: evaluate_narrow_judge / evaluate_broad_judge (3 LLMs, averaged) are used ONLY in eval_mode='generative'
correctness.reproducibility_caveat: row_seed = hash(f'{persona_id}_{content}') % 2**32 uses Python's str hash, which is randomised per process unless PYTHONHASHSEED is fixed; the official option shuffle is therefore not reproducible across runs by default. ReCoverMem would fix a deterministic per-row seed and record it.

history_boundary.mechanism: inference.py: full_chat_history = chat_history + [user_query_dict]; the query is appended AFTER the entire history, so there is no future segment
history_boundary.explicit_cutoff: not needed -- the cutoff is always the end of the history

leakage_probe.related_snippet_located_inside_history: 139 / 155 sampled rows fully matched; 16 not matched verbatim (whitespace/rewrites) -- none matched in the system message

history_dependence.clear_definition: distance_from_related_snippet_to_query_32k > 0, i.e. the evidence turn is strictly earlier in the history than the query
history_dependence.possible_definition: distance == 0; ALL 508 such rows are pref_type='sensitive_info', a pre-defined released category, so the subset is outcome-independent
history_dependence.design_note: v2's premise is that preferences are revealed IMPLICITLY inside unrelated requests (e.g. an allergy mentioned while asking for email wording help), so the query alone cannot contain the answer

split_feasibility.leakage_rule: all rows and both size-variants of a persona stay in one split; persona_id is the only grouping key needed (1 history per persona per size)

gates.enough_raw_history: PASS (32k: median 31,855 tokens ~= the whole 32,768 reader window; 128k: median 122,747 with median 83,488 irrelevant)
